name: dcat
label: DCAT v3 (Data Catalog)
description: W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary — used by US/UK/EU government open data portals
short_description: W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary — used by US/UK/EU government open data portals
long_description: DCAT v3 is the W3C recommendation for describing datasets and data services in interoperable machine-readable catalogs. The schema captures catalog metadata, dataset descriptions with spatial/temporal coverage and update frequency, distribution formats with download URLs, and reusable API data services.
when_to_use: Use for open data portals, enterprise data catalogs, data marketplace platforms, or any system publishing dataset metadata for discovery. Mandated by EU Open Data Directive for public sector bodies. US data.gov, UK data.gov.uk, EU data.europa.eu, and data.gov.au all use DCAT. Required for FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data compliance in scientific publishing.

table_notes.dcat_catalog: Top-level container grouping related datasets under a single publisher; one row per data portal or organizational catalog.
table_notes.dcat_dataset: Core metadata record for a logical dataset including spatial/temporal coverage, themes, and update frequency; references its parent catalog.
table_notes.dcat_distribution: Describes a specific downloadable or accessible form of a dataset (e.g. CSV, API, GeoJSON); multiple distributions per dataset are common.
table_notes.dcat_data_service: Describes a reusable API endpoint that serves one or more datasets; decoupled from any single dataset to support multi-dataset APIs.

dcat_catalog.name: id
dcat_catalog.description: Surrogate primary key for the catalog record

dcat_catalog.name: title
dcat_catalog.description: Human-readable name of the catalog (e.g. 'UK Government Open Data Portal')

dcat_catalog.name: description
dcat_catalog.description: Free-text description of the catalog scope and contents

dcat_catalog.name: publisher_name
dcat_catalog.description: Name of the organization responsible for publishing this catalog

dcat_catalog.name: publisher_url
dcat_catalog.description: URL of the publisher's homepage or organizational profile

dcat_catalog.name: lang_code
dcat_catalog.description: Primary language of catalog content as an IETF BCP 47 tag (e.g. en, fr, de)

dcat_catalog.name: license_url
dcat_catalog.description: URL of the default license governing datasets in this catalog (e.g. CC-BY 4.0)

dcat_catalog.name: issued
dcat_catalog.description: Date/time the catalog was first published

dcat_catalog.name: modified
dcat_catalog.description: Date/time the catalog record was last updated

dcat_dataset.name: id
dcat_dataset.description: Surrogate primary key for the dataset record

dcat_dataset.name: catalog_id
dcat_dataset.description: References the parent dcat_catalog that owns this dataset

dcat_dataset.name: description
dcat_dataset.description: Free-text description of the dataset contents, methodology, and coverage

dcat_dataset.name: identifier
dcat_dataset.description: Persistent unique identifier for the dataset (DOI, URI, or publisher-assigned ID)

dcat_dataset.name: keywords
dcat_dataset.description: Array of keyword strings for discovery (e.g. ["health", "mortality", "annual"])

dcat_dataset.name: themes
dcat_dataset.description: Array of theme URIs from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. EU Data Theme, schema.org)

dcat_dataset.name: publisher_name
dcat_dataset.description: Name of the organization responsible for this specific dataset (may differ from catalog publisher)

dcat_dataset.name: contact_point
dcat_dataset.description: Contact details object with keys: name, email, url (vCard/schema.org style)

dcat_dataset.name: spatial_coverage
dcat_dataset.description: PostGIS geometry defining the geographic area covered by this dataset (WGS84)

dcat_dataset.name: temporal_start
dcat_dataset.description: Start date of the time period covered by the dataset

dcat_dataset.name: temporal_end
dcat_dataset.description: End date of the time period covered by the dataset (NULL if ongoing)

dcat_dataset.name: update_frequency
dcat_dataset.description: How often the dataset is updated; use Dublin Core frequency terms (e.g. daily, monthly)

dcat_dataset.name: license_url
dcat_dataset.description: URL of the license governing this dataset; overrides the catalog-level license if set

dcat_dataset.name: issued
dcat_dataset.description: Date/time this dataset was first published

dcat_dataset.name: modified
dcat_dataset.description: Date/time the dataset metadata was last updated

dcat_dataset.name: landing_page_url
dcat_dataset.description: URL of the dataset's human-readable landing page for documentation and access

dcat_dataset.name: version
dcat_dataset.description: Version identifier of the dataset content (e.g. '2024-Q1', '3.0')

dcat_distribution.name: id
dcat_distribution.description: Surrogate primary key for the distribution record

dcat_distribution.name: dataset_id
dcat_distribution.description: References the dcat_dataset this distribution belongs to

dcat_distribution.name: title
dcat_distribution.description: Human-readable label for this distribution (e.g. 'CSV download', 'WMS endpoint')

dcat_distribution.name: access_url
dcat_distribution.description: URL giving access to the distribution (may be a landing page, API, or direct file)

dcat_distribution.name: download_url
dcat_distribution.description: Direct URL to download the file; more specific than access_url

dcat_distribution.name: media_type
dcat_distribution.description: IANA media type of the distribution (e.g. text/csv, application/geo+json)

dcat_distribution.name: format
dcat_distribution.description: File format label for human display (e.g. CSV, GeoJSON, Shapefile, Parquet)

dcat_distribution.name: byte_size
dcat_distribution.description: Approximate file size in bytes; used for consumer download planning

dcat_distribution.name: issued
dcat_distribution.description: Date/time this distribution was first made available

dcat_distribution.name: modified
dcat_distribution.description: Date/time this distribution was last updated

dcat_data_service.name: id
dcat_data_service.description: Surrogate primary key for the data service record

dcat_data_service.name: catalog_id
dcat_data_service.description: References the dcat_catalog that lists this service

dcat_data_service.name: title
dcat_data_service.description: Human-readable name of the API or service (e.g. 'SPARQL endpoint', 'WFS service')

dcat_data_service.name: endpoint_url
dcat_data_service.description: Root URL of the service endpoint consumers send requests to

dcat_data_service.name: endpoint_description
dcat_data_service.description: URL or text pointing to machine-readable API description (OpenAPI, WSDL, OGC CapabilitiesDoc)

dcat_data_service.name: serves_dataset
dcat_data_service.description: Array of dcat_dataset UUIDs that this service provides access to

dcat_data_service.name: contact_point
dcat_data_service.description: Contact details object with keys: name, email, url (vCard/schema.org style)
